wins: Captured detailed reconnaissance data and service banners for target hosts throughout the single episode.
Maintained consistent mentor engagement (10 calls) ensuring tactical adjustments based on feedback.
fails: Zero percent success rate; no high-value assets compromised, indicating limited progress beyond initial recon.
Fail state reached before establishing foothold or lateral movement, halting opportunity to validate exploit chains.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance momentum was preserved with robust logging, but execution stalled before exploitation, resulting in a failed run.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to progress past reconnaissance due to failure in exploiting identified services, causing episode termination before lateral movement.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is detected open with an SSH banner
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap ssh-brute and sshv1 scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service returns outdated Apache/nginx banner
skill_cards.then_action: Launch nikto scan focused on script vulnerabilities and outdated headers before running Metasploit auxiliary

skill_cards.if_condition: When service enumeration indicates default credentials in banner or API response
skill_cards.then_action: Automate credential validation using hydra passwords list followed by manual session validation

HTTP banner parsing consistently yields actionable vulnerabilities for follow-up scans
